amanda_cs: Starting Project Lynx preview today — 6 seats. Need: enablement checklist, SSO quickstart (Okta), telemetry/usage signals, and a short weekly feedback loop. Who can own the runbook + survey? :wave:
julian_csm: Saw their kickoff brief. They care about demo perf and SSO. Flagging renewal watch: if adoption stalls we escalate. Happy to run post-kickoff outreach. :flag-brown:
sam_ops: Put them on the tracker and created calendar stub https://go.redwood/field-trials/lynx-preview. I can take scheduling and dashboard tile for basic metrics. Preference for Wed 10am PT recurring check-in.
rebecca_pm: I can do the runbook + 3-question micro-survey. Draft survey: 1) How often did you use the integration this week? (daily/weekly/none) 2) Any blocking issues? 3) Latency OK? (yes/no) — will make numeric latency telemetry too.
tom_engineer: I'll put together an Okta OIDC quickstart + tiny test app. ETA: 48 hours. Need their Okta admin info (issuer, client_id). We can provide a mock metadata payload for kickoff if they don't have it ready.
amanda_cs: They've confirmed Okta and will send metadata by tomorrow AM. Also requested a short demo showing low-latency flows. Keep the demo <20m.
julian_csm: Proposed success signals: DAU >= 3 seats by week 1, avg latency < 250ms, zero SSO blockers. If week 2 DAU < 30% of expected, trigger exec escalation. Add those to the weekly scorecard.
sam_ops: I'll create a dashboard tile for DAU + avg latency + SSO error rate and wire an alert if DAU drops or error rate >5%. I'll also schedule Wed 10am PT weekly sync (30m).
rebecca_pm: Runbook outline: 1) Pre-kickoff checklist (metadata, accounts, test data) 2) Kickoff agenda (demo, SSO walkthrough, telemetry, Q&A) 3) Post-kickoff tasks (survey, follow-up tickets, 1:1 if risk). I'll post the doc to the tracker after the kickoff.
tom_engineer: Quickstart snippet for runbook (for kickoff demo):
```bash
# exchange SSO metadata (example)
curl -X POST https://lynx.example.com/api/sso/metadata -d '{"issuer":"https://org.okta.com","client_id":"lynx-demo-client"}'
```
I'll attach the test app repo link in the runbook.
ops_bot: Created ticket CS-4991: "Lynx preview onboarding" assigned to sam_ops, rebecca_pm, tom_engineer. https://tasks.redwood/CS-4991
amanda_cs: Ownership recap — Rebecca: runbook + survey; Tom: OIDC quickstart + demo app; Sam: tracker, scheduling, dashboard; Julian: renewal watch & escalation. Kickoff scheduled for Tue 10am PT (they requested earlier slot). I'll capture notes and share survey results in this thread. Drop blockers before EOD. :thumbsup:
